name: Question 18
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14063571/assets/93df9649232a5985eaefebd7180c8f40c6608d51fe8b993cf3da9a8473eb4612.png)

Evaluate the triple integral 
${∭}_{R}xz\,dV$
over the region $R,$ shown above.

*Hint: All surfaces, except for the right one, are parallel to the corresponding coordinate planes.*
worked_solution:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14063571/assets/b4428666d80d78dfa3a4e754df7e5b33ee7ee4a8712c617b4cef5400a9ba494d.png)

 

Notice that our solid can be written as the type III region

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,(x,z)\in D,\,\,0\le y\le 2-\frac{x}{8}-z},
$$

where

$$
D={(x,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 4,\,\,0\le z\le 1}
$$

is the projection of $R$ onto the $xz$-plane, shown below.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14063571/assets/61de9aa1f6230dafb68c99d1b6345ee49c30a6d2f3f4825e44e6032daac23335.png)

Hence, the type III representation of $R$ is

$$
R={(x,y,z)\,:\,0\le x\le 4,\,\,0\le z\le 1,\,\,0\le y\le 2-\frac{x}{8}-z}
$$

As a result, by writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

$$
{∭}_{R}xz\,\text{d}V={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2-x/8-z}xz\,dy\,dz\,dx.
$$

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $y$, treating $x$ and $z$ as constants: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}{\int }_{0}^{2-x/8-z}xz\,dy\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}[{\int }_{0}^{2-x/8-z}xz\,dy]dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}xz[y]_{y=0}^{y=2-x/8-z}\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}xz(2-\frac{x}{8}-z)\,dz\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}(2xz-\frac{{x}^{2}z}{8}-x{z}^{2})\,dz\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to $z$, treating $x$ as a constant: 

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{4}{\int }_{0}^{1}(2xz-\frac{{x}^{2}z}{8}-x{z}^{2})\,dz\,dx & ={\int }_{0}^{4}[{\int }_{0}^{1}(2xz-\frac{{x}^{2}z}{8}-x{z}^{2})\,dz]dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}{[x{z}^{2}-\frac{{x}^{2}{z}^{2}}{16}-\frac{x{z}^{3}}{3}]}_{z=0}^{z=1}\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}(x-\frac{{x}^{2}}{16}-\frac{x}{3})\,dx \\  & ={\int }_{0}^{4}(\frac{2x}{3}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{16})\,dx\end{aligned}
$$

 

Finally, we integrate with respect to $x:$

$$
\begin{aligned}{\int }_{0}^{4}(\frac{2x}{3}-\frac{{x}^{2}}{16})\,dx & ={[\frac{{x}^{2}}{3}-\frac{{x}^{3}}{48}]}_{x=0}^{x=4} \\  & =(\frac{16}{3}-\frac{64}{48})-0 \\  & =4.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

Notice that our solid can be written as the type III region

R={(x,y,z):(x,z)∈D,0≤y≤2−x8−z},

where

D={(x,z):0≤x≤4,0≤z≤1}

is the projection of R onto the xz-plane, shown below.

Hence, the type III representation of R is

R={(x,y,z):0≤x≤4,0≤z≤1,0≤y≤2−x8−z}

As a result, by writing down our triple integral as a repeated integral, we obtain

∭RxzdV=∫04∫01∫02−x/8−zxzdydzdx.

First, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to y, treating x and z as constants:

∫04∫01∫02−x/8−zxzdydzdx=∫04∫01[∫02−x/8−zxzdy]dzdx=∫04∫01xz[y]y=0y=2−x/8−zdzdx=∫04∫01xz(2−x8−z)dzdx=∫04∫01(2xz−x2z8−xz2)dzdx

Next, we evaluate the inner integral with respect to z, treating x as a constant:

∫04∫01(2xz−x2z8−xz2)dzdx=∫04[∫01(2xz−x2z8−xz2)dz]dx=∫04[xz2−x2z216−xz33]z=0z=1dx=∫04(x−x216−x3)dx=∫04(2x3−x216)dx

Finally, we integrate with respect to x:

∫04(2x3−x216)dx=[x23−x348]x=0x=4=(163−6448)−0=4.
